_comment: The first relic set (LOOT_SITES_SPEC.md §7). Ten relics, six live effects, two honest trinkets, two dormant promises. Relics are UNIQUE PER RUN -- once one has dropped it is out of every table, which is why effects are additive and unstacked. A relic in hand grants NOTHING: effects activate on deposit at the lair (§7's carry rule, the banking rule applied to power), which is what keeps 'drop it and run' a live choice on the return leg. Effect keys the code implements: attribute (any of COMBAT_SPEC §2.1's nine), move_speed_mult, carry_delta, heal_at_dawn, fog_reveal_delta. An effect marked dormant:true is data with no consumer yet -- the panel says so out loud rather than shipping a lie.

relics.name: A Tarnished Locket
relics.description: Somebody's whole world, closed on a face nobody living remembers.

relics.name: Coins for the Ferryman
relics.description: Taken from under a tongue. The ferryman will have to wait.

relics.name: The Sexton's Ring
relics.description: He opened graves for forty years and was buried in one. The hands remember.

relics.name: A Wolf-Hide Cloak
relics.description: Cured badly, stinking, and warm. The snow does not slow whoever wears it.

relics.name: The Pallbearer's Gloves
relics.description: Leather worn smooth by the weight of other people.

relics.name: A Chipped Censer
relics.description: It still holds a little of whatever they were burning to keep you out.

relics.name: A Noble's Seal
relics.description: A house that has never had to prove itself, pressed into wax.

relics.name: The Sermon of Ash
relics.description: Heresy, written out in a careful hand by someone who believed it.

relics.name: A Barrow Lantern
relics.description: It was lit when you found it. Nobody has been down there in three hundred years.

relics.name: The Ledger of Names
relics.description: Every name in it is dead. Most of them are still listening.
